domain_invariants.requirement: An actuator has a unique positive id, an existing owner, a unique serial matching ^[A-Z0-9-]{6,32}$, a name of 1..80 characters, and type SWITCH, DIMMER, or THERMOSTAT.
Legal actuator commands are SWITCH ON or OFF, DIMMER integer 0..100, and THERMOSTAT decimal 5.0..35.0 Celsius; a command value outside its type capability is invalid.

An automation rule has an owner, a per-owner unique name of 3..80 characters, enabled boolean, source_kind TEMPERATURE, HUMIDITY, or MOTION, comparator GT, GTE, LT, LTE, or EQ, threshold in -50.0..5000.0, and cooldown_seconds 0..86400.
A rule has one to five actions targeting distinct existing actuators owned by the same user as the rule. Each action has order 1..5 and a command valid for its actuator under REQ-2-002.
An automation event is immutable, has a client_event_id matching ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$ unique per owner, a UTC occurred_at timestamp with second precision, and a numeric value within -50.0..5000.0.

For an accepted event, enabled matching rules are evaluated in ascending rule id. A rule executes at most once per client_event_id and is suppressed when its last successful execution is fewer than cooldown_seconds before the event occurred_at.

Creating an execution atomically creates ordered command records and updates each target actuator current_value to the action value; command and execution records are immutable audit history with outcome APPLIED or SUPPRESSED.
Manual commands are immutable audit records with origin MANUAL and update the target actuator atomically; automation commands have origin RULE and reference one immutable execution.

An actuator cannot be deleted while referenced by a rule action or any command. Deleting a rule deletes only its action definitions and retains execution and command snapshots; an executed rule cannot be deleted.
A user may access and operate only actuators, rules, events, executions, and commands owned by that user; an admin may access all. Private routes deny by default.

seed_data: Deterministic local users exist with ids 1 and 2 in role user and id 3 in role admin; valid non-expired server-side Bearer sessions authenticate private requests and their values are never returned.

All list endpoints return items and next_after_id in ascending immutable numeric id order, use limit 1..100 default 20 and optional after_id > 0, and return null next_after_id at exhaustion. Optional enum filters are exact matches; optional actuator_id and rule_id filters require existing positive ids.

All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 with second precision. Private routes deny by default. Invalid JSON is 400; write bodies require application/json and otherwise are 415; invalid structures and field values are 422. Local persistence failure is 503 and unexpected local failure is 500 with no partial write.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health as a public endpoint without input or authorization; it shall report deterministic local persistence health without reading or changing domain data and emit only 200 or 503.

The system shall expose GET /actuators as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting optional type enum, serial_prefix of 1..32 uppercase serial characters, owner_id for admins only, limit, and after_id; it shall apply exact and normalized-prefix filtering, enforce REQ-2-010, paginate stably, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /actuators as an admin-only endpoint accepting application/json owner_id, serial, name, type, and initial_value valid for the type; it shall validate REQ-2-001 and REQ-2-002, require a positive existing owner, reject duplicate serials, atomically create the actuator, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /actuators/{actuator_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall return the actuator and current_value after authorization, make no persistent changes, treat non-positive or absent ids as 404, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetActuator(request, actuator_id):
    // REQ-2-014; Preconditions: persistence available. REQUIRE authenticated caller or RETURN 401.
    IF actuator_id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404. IF user caller is not owner THEN RETURN 403. END IF
    READ actuator; RETURN 200. // Transaction: none; postcondition: state is unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /actuators/{actuator_id} as an admin-only endpoint accepting application/json with one or both of name and owner_id; it shall validate a non-empty patch and REQ-2-001, atomically update only supplied metadata without changing command history or rule relations, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /actuators/{actuator_id} as an admin-only endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall atomically delete only an actuator without rule-action or command references, shall not cascade-delete audit records, be non-idempotent after success, return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /actuators/{actuator_id}/commands as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json value; it shall validate REQ-2-002, atomically create an immutable MANUAL APPLIED command and set current_value, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /actuators/{actuator_id}/commands as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id, optional origin enum MANUAL or RULE, limit, and after_id; it shall return command history with exact origin filtering and stable pagination, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /automation-rules as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting optional enabled boolean, source_kind enum, owner_id for admins only, limit, and after_id; it shall apply exact filters, enforce REQ-2-010, paginate stably, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /automation-rules as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json name, source_kind, comparator, threshold, cooldown_seconds, and one to five ordered actions; an admin may additionally provide owner_id while a user is always owner; it shall validate REQ-2-003 and REQ-2-004, reject duplicate owner names, atomically create rule and action definitions, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /automation-rules/{rule_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall return the rule and ordered action definitions without persistent effects, treat non-positive or absent ids as 404, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose PUT /automation-rules/{rule_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a complete application/json replacement of name, source_kind, comparator, threshold, cooldown_seconds, enabled, and actions; it shall validate REQ-2-003 and REQ-2-004, reject duplicate owner names, atomically replace only action definitions while retaining execution and command history, be idempotent for an identical valid representation, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /automation-rules/{rule_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall atomically delete an unexecuted rule and its action definitions only, retain no orphan actions, reject an executed rule to preserve audit history, be non-idempotent after success, return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /automation-rules/{rule_id}/enable as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting no body; it shall atomically set enabled true, be idempotent when already enabled, preserve actions and audit relations, return 200, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /automation-rules/{rule_id}/disable as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting no body; it shall atomically set enabled false, be idempotent when already disabled, preserve actions and audit relations, return 200, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /automation-events as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json client_event_id, source_kind, value, and occurred_at; an admin may additionally provide owner_id while a user is always owner; it shall validate REQ-2-005, atomically persist a new event and process rules under REQ-2-006 and REQ-2-007, return the prior result idempotently for an identical duplicate event, return 201 with Location for a new event or 200 for a duplicate, and emit only 200, 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /automation-executions as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting optional rule_id, outcome enum APPLIED or SUPPRESSED, client_event_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate filters, enforce ownership through the execution owner, use stable pagination, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.
